newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Hardie on track for year profit rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Hardie on track for year profit rise.

text.p: Building products group James Hardie Ltd said on Thursday that it was on budget so far for a significant improvement in profit for the year to March 31, 1998.
"We're on budget in total in April and May," James Hardie Managing Director Keith Barton told a briefing for analysts and reporters in Sydney.
A James Hardie spokesman said Barton was referring to the group's forecast earlier on Thursday of significant improvement in after tax profit in the current year to March 31, 1998.
Barton said conditions in the Australian and New Zealand building materials markets would remain tough in the current year, with falling volumes and earnings.
But this Australasian weakness would be over-powered by continued strong earnings growth from Hardie's U.S. operations.

Barton said that Hardie's U.S. building products operations were, however, likely to experience price pressure in the year ahead as new building products competition entered the market and as Hardie looked to increase its presence in the engineered wood products market.
"Pricing is going to come off if anthing as we penetrate the more difficult markets," Barton said.
"We may have to discount...be more aggressive against engineered wood products and against PVC," he said.
"But that doesn't necessarily mean a reduction in margins," he said.
